title: Evidence-bound Wow! signal hypothesis matrix
description: A machine-readable matrix separating supported shape models, compatible source functions, unresolved origin discrimination, and unestablished symbolic or extraterrestrial claims.
rights_statement: The local hypothesis matrix is original project metadata licensed with the repository. Rights in cited external publications and webpages remain with their respective authors and publishers.

artifacts.description: Validated hypotheses, scopes, evidence-bound statuses, rationale, strengthening conditions, weakening conditions, and limitations.

sources.creator: Jerry R. Ehman

sources.publisher: Ohio State University Radio Observatory / Big Ear
sources.role: Primary historical source for the surviving observation, acquisition timing, beam-transit interpretation, and limits of the retained measurements.
